original_message: The checkout page already has a working payment button: the `<button type="submit" id="pay-button">Pay now</button>` inside `#checkout-form`, wired in `/app.js` to POST the cart and selected method to `/api/checkout`, disable itself while processing, and show the success or failure result in `#result`. No changes were needed, so I left the files untouched to avoid breaking the existing flow.
